decisive_join: Join the competence critique, standardized competency templates, global assessment vendors, and applicant-tracking throughput into one distributed selection transaction with retained authorship.

findings.claim: A reform aimed at contextual competence can be compressed into standardized traits and sold as portable person-job fit.
limits: The degree of compression varies by instrument and implementation.

findings.claim: Internet recruiting made disposal throughput a first-order operating objective, creating strong incentives for cheap, comparable, defensible signals.
limits: The seed does not establish that every ATS automatically rejects or that every employer uses the same workflow.

findings.claim: Distributed vendor-employer authorship can make an adverse exertion appear ownerless unless role, instrument, threshold, and final judgment are joined.
limits: Exact contractual and decision authority must be recovered per deployment.

observations.notes: The seed presents McClelland as a contextual reform rather than as the endpoint.
